description: Current adaptive ECG workflows plus preserved historical ReusePlan and FlowThrough profiles.
historical_profile_note: Every other profile is retained with its original stages, gates, labels, and results for historical reproduction; it cannot authorize a current ECG final stage.

profiles.ecg_grasp_reference_cache: Four serial SpMV Patents8MiB reference-consumer cells: fresh GRASP/intact favorable P-OPT, and GRASP-based FULL/FLAT diagnostics with identical complete matrix preparation and ideal runtime rank availability. Not an ECG mask or native-speed claim.
profiles.ecg_governed_first_cache: Four serial Patents 8MiB cells isolating opt-in governed-first eviction on the current NEXT record replacement rule: SpMV and PageRank, each with the option off and on and everything else identical. The control is the same-build off arm. Not a competitiveness claim against GRASP or P-OPT.
profiles.ecg_expiry_attribution_cache: Six serial Patents 8MiB cells re-reading the six attribution cells with the expiry instrument: stored line state and bounds expired against filtered progress. Instrument reading with no performance gate.
profiles.ecg_matched_baseline_cache: Serial Patents 8MiB baseline cells at the current build, on the same graphs and geometry as the governed-first cells. The SpMV pair is confirmatory, since GRASP_PAPER and POPT:UNCHARGED are already byte-identical across the 074cbf75, bb7689a9 and 2b00f213 studies. The PageRank pair is a first reading, because no matched PageRank baseline exists and POPT:UNCHARGED was never measured for PageRank on this graph. Not itself a competitiveness claim.
profiles.ecg_capacity_generality_cache: Eight serial Patents cells at 24MiB/16-way repeating the dense comparison measured at 8MiB: SpMV and PageRank, each with GRASP_PAPER, POPT:UNCHARGED, ECG base-first and ECG governed-first. One capacity change, everything else identical. Tests whether the dense result is capacity-general or specific to 8MiB; the mitigation has a reason to weaken where there is less capacity pressure, and a shrinking margin is the predicted direction.
profiles.ecg_victim_attribution_cache: Six serial Patents 8MiB cells reading the passive ECG record victim-path attribution instrument: SpMV, BFS, SSSP and BC on the GRASP record base, SSSP on the LRU record base, and PageRank. Instrument reading, not a candidate: it adds receipt fields only and must reproduce the existing competitive kernel totals.
profiles.ecg_consumer_architecture_cache: Four serial SpMV Patents8MiB consumer-architecture cells: fresh ordinary GRASP, fresh intact favorable P-OPT, and the GRASP-based FULL base-first and RANK rank-first diagnostics sharing one identical complete matrix and one identical engagement boundary. Isolates selection architecture, not information quality. Not an ECG mask, competitiveness or native-speed claim.
profiles.ecg_frontier_mask_cache: Four final serial Patents BFS8MiB budget cells: fresh phased GRASP and intact favorable P-OPT, plus B frontier masks with identical paid counters/context and gating ignored/enabled. RRPV7 only; no graph/source/threshold sweep or native claim.
profiles.ecg_popt_rank_attribution: Six serial full-Patents SpMV/TD-BFS8MiB cells: strong applicable GRASP, intact favorable P-OPT, and explicitly labeled constant-rank P-OPT diagnostics. No new mask, runtime lookup charge, capacity reduction or native timing claim.
profiles.ecg_window_phased_cache: Five serial Patents BFS8MiB cells: phased GRASP and unchanged favorableP-OPT versus windowT/R6/R7 with the same outside-pass LRU treatment. Window controls are not double-charged.
profiles.ecg_bfs_phase_cache: Three serial same-work Patents BFS8MiB cells with phase/role attribution: unchanged GRASP, unchanged favorable P-OPT, and GRASP in graph passes/LRU outside. No masks or traversal changes.

ecg_grasp_reference_cache.reason: New four-run budget after the exhausted twelve-run study. Isolates graph-rank value in a fixed GRASP-base consumer before any new producer; no WINDOW/B retuning or automatic A implementation.

development_gate.additional_requirement: full strictly improves kernel transfers over fresh ordinary GRASP
development_gate.popt_comparison: report against intact P-OPT separately without weakening it

ecg_governed_first_cache.reason: Approved budget `governed-first-4`. attribution-6 measured SpMV and PageRank at 99.9% and 98.5% live bound coverage with the override firing on 44.1% and 60.8% of evictions, yet both still lose to intact P-OPT, so their deficit is in what the comparison decides rather than in the information. The base victim is not governed on 39.1% and 34.7% of their evictions, which is exactly where a governed-first rule acts and the current rule cannot. The repository's own teaching fixture specifies this order and the default rule lacks it.

development_gate.control: the same-build option-off arm, never the 074cbf75 study
development_gate.minimum_margin_scope: must hold on BOTH spmv and pr to confirm C3
development_gate.partial: a margin on one kernel only is reported as partial and must not be generalised from the winner
development_gate.reject_meaning: governed-first does not pay on the kernels where the mask is best covered; record as a negative result rather than widening it to other kernels or bases
development_gate.negative_lift: reported as a regression, never discarded
development_gate.hardware_cost: one governed bit per line, already present as WayState::property, and one comparison across ways that the cache already performs for LRU; no new storage, ports or metadata traffic
development_gate.excluded: bfs, sssp and bc are out of scope: at 8.9-26.6% live coverage their deficit is information at the moment of choice, which an ordering rule cannot supply

ecg_capacity_generality_cache.reason: Every dense result is one graph at one capacity, which the repository's own rules treat as a selection risk. The core corpus stays gated, so this tests the other axis on the established graph. Preregistered in NEXT.md section ai, including a prediction that the governed-first margin shrinks at 24MiB because the mitigation depends on capacity pressure.

development_gate.metric: kernel_total_offchip_traffic for spmv, total_offchip_traffic for pr
development_gate.formula: does ECG governed-first lead both baselines at 24MiB
development_gate.leads_both: dense capacity generality holds at a second point and the claim may name 8 and 24 MiB
development_gate.leads_grasp_only: partial; the P-OPT margin is capacity dependent and must be stated as holding at 8MiB only, with the 24MiB figure printed beside it
development_gate.leads_neither: the dense result is specific to 8MiB and is reported that way, without widening graph, capacity set or interpretation to recover it
development_gate.regression: any regression against the base-first arm is reported, never discarded
development_gate.predicted_before_running: the governed-first lift over base-first shrinks at 24MiB on both kernels, structural misses stay near-identical across arms, and P-OPT's relative standing improves
development_gate.not_claimed: nothing about a second graph, nothing about timing, and no revision to the filtered-kernel finding

ecg_matched_baseline_cache.reason: The governed-first result is gated arm-to-arm on kernel transfers and stands on its own. Its context against the named baselines is currently cross-study: the ECG control reproduces the 074cbf75 cell byte-identically on both phases, and GRASP_PAPER and POPT:UNCHARGED are byte-identical across three studies on three builds. The one untested link is whether those baselines still reproduce at the current build, which these two cells settle for about four minutes.

development_gate.confirm_meaning: both baselines within 0.5 percent of the expected figure confirms the cross-study context recorded in NEXT.md section ab, and the comparison may then be stated as one matched build
development_gate.reject_meaning: either baseline drifting beyond 0.5 percent withdraws the cross-study context entirely; only the arm-to-arm gate in section aa stands, and the drift is reported as the finding
development_gate.not_claimed: no setup-inclusive competitiveness claim under any outcome, and beating a baseline on kernel transfers is not a claim about the complete design

pagerank_gate.formula: first matched reading, not a lift and not a reproduction of a matched figure, because none exists for PageRank
pagerank_gate.report: both baselines reported as measured against the governed-first arm at 13011200 and its control at 16961478, whatever the direction
pagerank_gate.corroboration_only: GRASP_PAPER within 0.5 percent of 15976776 additionally corroborates the cross-build local_release_cache table recorded in NEXT.md section ag; drift beyond that withdraws that table and is reported as the finding
pagerank_gate.popt_uncharged_note: no prior PageRank POPT:UNCHARGED figure exists on this graph, so its value is a first reading with nothing to reproduce
pagerank_gate.not_claimed: PageRank's governed-first margin is largely recovery of the benefit removed by c1dce8bb, per section ag, and that framing stands regardless of how these baselines land

ecg_expiry_attribution_cache.reason: Approved budget `expiry-6`. Fixture readings show ~72% of held FINITE bounds are already expired against filtered progress in BFS, BC and SSSP, located at the victimState collapse in ecg_record_runtime.h. This replaces those fixture shares with real 8 MiB/16-way numbers. Instrument only: it adds receipt fields and changes no selection.

development_gate.gate: no performance gate: this profile cannot promote, reject or rank any candidate
development_gate.validity_check: each cell must reproduce its victim_attribution_patents_3a70798f kernel and setup totals; a difference invalidates the reading rather than constituting a result
development_gate.known_incomparability: the two SSSP cells cannot be compared to competitive_8mb_patents_074cbf75 because a256ee83 rewrote the filtered-traversal construction path

ecg_victim_attribution_cache.reason: Passive decision-path attribution for ecg_record::selectVictim. The 42-cell competitive study at 074cbf75 shows each algorithm loses differently, but the receipts carry no branch counts, so the consumer-ceiling and coverage causes are inferred rather than measured. This reads them directly. The instrument is proven passive by a 20000-trial randomized unit test; it adds ten receipt fields and changes no selection.

development_gate.gate: no performance gate: this profile cannot promote, reject or rank any candidate
development_gate.validity_check: each cell must reproduce its competitive_8mb_patents_074cbf75 kernel and setup totals; a difference invalidates the reading rather than constituting a result

ecg_consumer_architecture_cache.reason: Separately approved four-run budget `consumer-architecture-4`. The reference study gave a GRASP-based consumer the byte-identical intact P-OPT matrix, digest 3683564403557561320, and it still closed only 29.42% of the ordinary-GRASP-to-P-OPT kernel gap, with the residual 100.03% property demand misses. This isolates whether the base-first refinement architecture rather than the information caps that gain. Does not reopen the closed 12/12 or 4/4 budgets and authorizes no follow-on.

development_gate.interpretation: fraction of the FULL-to-intact-P-OPT kernel residual that rank-first selection alone recovers
development_gate.reject_meaning: rank-first ordering and tie discipline do not explain the residual; PASS_RANK as specified should be rejected, not rescued by widening eligibility or adding bits
development_gate.scope_caveat: RANK shares FULL's engagement boundary, so it isolates ordering plus tie-set aging while holding fixed the early return when the GRASP victim is not covered property data. This is conservative and can only understate rank-first's value.
development_gate.divergence_caveat: basefirst_divergence understates the treatment: rank-first additionally ages only the maximum-rank tie set while base-first ages every line, so the arms can differ even at zero divergence. Report max_rank_tie_population alongside it.
development_gate.popt_comparison: report against intact P-OPT separately without weakening it

stages.name: 31_gem5_record_width_4b
stages.notes: Compact 4-byte two-stamp record that substitutes for the CSR edge. Reports execution time, dram_offchip_bytes and dram_bus_util_pct. Expected behavior: with low DRAM utilization, reduced exposed misses should help both widths; with high utilization, the 8-byte arm should lose in proportion to traffic. Scope: gem5 PageRank only; the other kernels use 8-byte records. FlowThrough variants are excluded because their stream-load instruction is 8-byte only. ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE aborts before the ROI on a width mismatch.

Scope: gem5 PageRank only; the other kernels use 8-byte records. FlowThrough variants are excluded because their stream-load instruction is 8-byte only. stages.name: 40_isa_fused_4b
stages.notes: Fused ReuseBind-Indexed delivery, compact 4-byte record. Includes ECG:REUSE_PLAN_LRU so the replacement rule and the transport can be separated within the run. Every stage carries its OWN LRU cell so no ratio needs a denominator from another run: two nominally identical LRU cells were measured 1.74% apart in time purely because the guest's property arrays landed one page apart, which is the noise floor for cross-run ratios. Enforcement is live here (ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE reaches the guest and aborts pre-ROI), unlike the earlier width matrix.

Enforcement is live here (ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE reaches the guest and aborts pre-ROI), unlike the earlier width matrix.

stages.name: 44_isa_plain_8b
stages.notes: Non-fused 8-byte arm: the width reference for 42 and 43. Every stage carries its OWN LRU cell so no ratio needs a denominator from another run: two nominally identical LRU cells were measured 1.74% apart in time purely because the guest's property arrays landed one page apart, which is the noise floor for cross-run ratios. Enforcement is live here (ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE reaches the guest and aborts pre-ROI), unlike the earlier width matrix.

stages.name: 50_fused_compact_4b
stages.notes: Serialized single-core TimingSimple compact ReuseBind-Indexed arm; exact request binding is proven separately by the O3 mechanism probe. Runtime activation is attested by ECG_REUSE_BIND_ILOAD_C; the runner fails if the guest does not emit it. Every stage carries its own LRU and ReusePlan-LRU, and all stages use one build.

stages.name: 51_fused_software_4b
stages.notes: Matched serialized TimingSimple compact arm using the existing 64-bit fused ReuseBind-Indexed load after guest software widening. Decode control for stage 50.

stages.name: 52_fused_wide_8b
stages.notes: Matched serialized TimingSimple wide ReuseBind-Indexed arm. Implementation-width control for stage 50; every stage carries its own LRU and ReusePlan-LRU and all stages use one build.

stages.name: 60_gem5_proposal_reuse_bind_o3
stages.notes: Mechanism-only gate with a width-unmatched 8-byte non-FlowThrough ReusePlan semantic anchor plus transport-matched 4-byte FlowThrough lru_only and epoch_first arms. roi_matrix forces capped 2048-event ReuseBind and FlowThrough traces; every FlowThrough row must attest only 4-byte request-flag record loads, exact same-line O3 ReuseBind Request acceptance, and multiple nonzero record-derived plans. All three rows must match PageRank semantics. The anchor is not a FlowThrough control, and this proves existence and binding rather than request-count or performance coverage.

stages.name: 61_gem5_csr_transport_cit_i1
stages.notes: Single bounded transport calibration. Per-array x requestor LLC attribution must reconcile exactly before comparing the ReusePlan-LRU FlowThrough control with its same-job LRU denominator; no broader stage is unlocked by this run. Scope is single-core CPU data/instruction demand traffic with prefetching disabled. Unclassified-other CPU-data demand misses must remain at or below 2%. The graph is symmetrized, so incoming and outgoing CSR edge/index storage aliases; directed-graph attribution requires exporting the outgoing index range separately.

stages.name: 62_cache_sim_matched_policy_replay
stages.notes: Every ReusePlan arm uses identical 4-byte FlowThrough transport. T-OPT retains the common warm prefix to establish cache state, marks the cache-stat reset as ROI start, fingerprints only ROI requests, and counts oracle hits/misses only in the ROI suffix; next-use optimization still sees the full warm+ROI sequence. The runner requires the exact six-arm ReusePlan roster to produce one identical post-L2 address/class/read-write fingerprint and Belady result, checks ROI trace accesses equal measured LLC accesses, and requires the oracle floor not exceed measured misses before comparing victim rules. LRU and native GRASP are reference rows with explicitly independent oracle-group hashes.

stages.name: 63_gem5_shortcircuit_cit_i1
stages.notes: Single replay-promoted timing cell. The 4-byte compact record is fail-closed, per-array attribution must validate, FlowThrough records must cold-miss exactly once per line, and all comparisons use one local LRU denominator. This is one n18 sample point, not a general performance claim.

stages.name: 64_gem5_epoch_attribution_cit_i1
stages.notes: Decisive epoch-efficacy cell. All ReusePlan arms use identical 4-byte compact FlowThrough transport. Resettable replacement-policy counters quantify request validity, live stamped ways, context mismatches, zero-stamped selections, stamped victims selected through an epoch-capable path, epoch-decisive selections from a metadata-disabled shadow decision, and victim-way concentration. Eligibility is a liveness check; only the decisive counter shows that epoch metadata changed a victim. Compare RRIP-first against GRASP-only for the combined RRIP path, and epoch-first against the records-first/property-LRU arm for an exact runtime epoch contrast. Do not infer a future-reference benefit from RRIP behavior alone.

stages.name: 65_gem5_rrip_epoch_attribution_cit_i1
stages.notes: Applied positional counterfactual. RRIP-no-epoch keeps the exact RRIP eligibility gate, records-first selection, insertion, transport, and guest work of RRIP-first while replacing epoch distance with fixed set order. This stage measures epoch-path versus positional selection; stage 66 supplies the neutral property-recency epoch-information test. GRASP-only and transport-LRU remain local decomposition controls.

stages.name: 66_gem5_rrip_recency_attribution_cit_i1
stages.notes: Neutral epoch-information test. All three ReusePlan arms share RRIP eligibility, aging, records-first selection, insertion, compact transport, and guest work. The positional control chooses the first property candidate; the neutral control chooses the oldest property candidate; RRIP-first uses epoch distance. Epoch information is useful only if RRIP-first materially beats the recency control.

stages.name: 67_cache_sim_future_admission_i1
stages.notes: Signal gate, not a novelty claim. The recency-admission treatment and recency control differ only in future-distance admission/refresh. The future-tier arm tests the intended combined mask at eviction: future distance first, carried GRASP tier on epoch ties, then recency. The combined-admission arm averages tier and future RRPV. The admission+epoch arm completes the admission x eviction interaction. All ReusePlan arms share compact records and FlowThrough; LRU and GRASP receive the same generic structural FlowThrough opportunity. scripts/experiments/ecg/analysis/future_admission_gate.py compares each treatment to its named matched control using the unweighted geometric mean of per-graph ratios. Promote to gem5 only if a treatment reaches at most 0.97 for both LLC misses and total off-chip traffic, with neither metric above 1.02 on any graph. P-OPT/Hawkeye comparison remains mandatory before any novelty claim.

stages.name: 68_cache_sim_temporal_discrimination_i1
stages.notes: Mechanism discrimination, not a performance claim. Both symmetrized graphs derive from 65,536-vertex, degree-eight directed inputs and have identical serialized counts and degree sequences. Clustered readers are adjacent in the preserved vertex sweep; spread readers are separated across the graph. GRASP receives the same degree distribution in both cells. This stage isolates eviction ranking; admission is evaluated on the real-graph stage because clustered reuse is absorbed by private caches and produces no LLC admission updates. A future-mask policy must respond to the timing change while preserving exact semantics and symmetric FlowThrough.

stages.name: 69_gem5_temporal_admission_i1
stages.notes: Mechanism-only matched O3 test on the directed spread-reader graph. Both rows use the corrected builder-v2 mask, compact 4-byte FlowThrough records, request-bound ReuseBind, RRIP eligibility/aging, and property-recency eviction. Only future-distance admission/refresh changes. Array-attribution schema 2 separately accounts incoming traversal and outgoing-degree CSR offsets. One architectural record sweep is required; O3 replay may add at most 0.5% record-line misses, while a second sweep remains fail-closed. This synthetic control cannot support a general performance or novelty claim.

stages.name: 69b_cache_sim_online_admission_i1
stages.notes: Historical generation-1 fixed-color gate. At commit 0353f4a5, sets 7-14 provided four alternating leaders per arm; online misses and total off-chip traffic had to remain within 1.02 of the better static arm on every graph. The gate failed because those colors were not representative. The profile is blocked so current generation-2 code cannot silently overwrite that evidence. Use the tracked generation-2 color-sweep flow and its separate analyzer.

stages.name: 96_gem5_transport_i1
stages.notes: Transport screen cell. Both arms select victims with LRU and both run structural FlowThrough, so only graph representation, request path, and record transport differ.

stages.name: 97_gem5_transport_i8
stages.notes: Iteration-8 robustness role. Requires a valid transport screen GO receipt.

stages.name: 98_cache_sim_transport_wide16
stages.notes: Five-graph 8-byte wide-record control matched cell-for-cell against stage 99. Symmetric structural FlowThrough supersedes the duplicate static record FlowThrough path and must emit the explicit subsumption receipt. soc-LiveJournal1 is excluded because its 23 destination bits plus 2 tier bits and two 4-bit epochs require 33 bits.

stages.name: 99_cache_sim_transport_compact16
stages.notes: Five-graph 4-byte compact-record role. Same graphs, kernels, policies, and FlowThrough setting as stage 98. Symmetric structural FlowThrough supersedes the duplicate static record FlowThrough path and must emit the explicit subsumption receipt; no compact full-graph claim is made for soc-LiveJournal1.

stages.name: 100_sniper_transport_matched
stages.notes: Bounded matched-work corroboration of demand LLC load misses only. The certified prefix binds each fused record by current source plus exact bound property address, preserving distinct per-edge hints for vertices that share a line; marker-free fallback is line-range lookup under pure LRU replacement. Sniper exposes no byte-level off-chip traffic for this role, excludes writeback bytes from l3_misses, and supplies no admissible timing.
